refuter.evidence: src/r2ext.cob at --std 85: an EXTERNAL FD declared in the outer program (FILE STATUS FS-O) and in a contained program (FILE STATUS FS-I). Inner OPEN of the connector the outer opened gave INNER-REOPEN 41 into FS-I while FS-O stayed OO (OUTER-AFTER-CALL OO); inner CLOSE 00 into FS-I; outer WRITE after that close gave 48 into FS-O. Mixed-mode multi-file OPEN OUTPUT XA INPUT XB (XB absent): MULTI-OPEN 00 35, and CLOSE XB XA: MULTI-CLOSE 00 42, each into its own file's item. So the item updated is that of the file control entry of the program whose statement ran, even when two entries share one connector. cite.py: OK §1985:VII.2.5.4 GR2 the text is in GR2.
